name: Lacustrine-Cairn
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by massive canyon systems near the terminator.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Instruments disagree about the spatial rift remnant: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
